spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright
spells.components: V, M (a drop of your blood)
spells.summary: With a gasp and loud proclamation, you seem to fall dead to the ground. Instead of being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you are reduced to a number of Hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At the same time, you have the Invisible condition, and an illusion of your dea
spells.body:
Level 5 Illusion (Bard, Cleric, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard)

Casting time: Reaction, which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright

Range: Self

Components: V, M (a drop of your blood)

Duration: Concentration , up to 1 hour

With a gasp and loud proclamation, you seem to fall dead to the ground. Instead of being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you are reduced to a number of Hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At the same time, you have the Invisible condition, and an illusion of your dead body appears, lying in the space where your body would have fallen.

If a creature takes the Study action to examine your illusory body, the creature can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ( Investigation ) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

The Invisible condition ends if you take the Attack action, use the Magic action to cast a spell that lets a creature regain Hit Points, or use any action to cause harm to a creature.

spells.name: Branch and Root of Yggdrasil
spells.components: V, S, M (branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree)
spells.summary: All trees are intrinsically linked to Yggdrasil. When you cast this spell and touch a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures in contact with that tree are transported to a random location on Yggdrasil. If you are touching a World Tree found on the mortal plane (such as those
spells.body:
Level 5 Conjuration (Druid)

Casting time: Action or Ritual

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree)

Duration: Instantaneous

All trees are intrinsically linked to Yggdrasil. When you cast this spell and touch a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures in contact with that tree are transported to a random location on Yggdrasil. If you are touching a World Tree found on the mortal plane (such as those found in the Northlands) when you cast the spell, you can specify a target destination on Yggdrasil in general terms, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the GM.

Using this magic requires a sacrifice from the caster. After casting this spell, your Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of one of your Hit Dice until you complete a Long Rest.

###H4### Spells (C-E)

spells.name: Call to Action
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to another creature’s turn starting
spells.summary: The creature starting its turn may immediately use its Reaction to take the Dash , Disengage , Dodge , or Help action.
spells.body:
Level 2 Enchantment (Bard, Paladin)

Casting time: Reaction, which you take in response to another creature’s turn starting

Range: 60 feet

Components: V

Duration: Instantaneous

The creature starting its turn may immediately use its Reaction to take the Dash , Disengage , Dodge , or Help action.

spells.name: Claws of the Bear
spells.components: V, S, M (a tuft of bear fur)
spells.summary: You imbue yourself with the claws of a bear. You transform your arms into a pair of muscular, furred paws and make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to 3d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier and, if the target is no more
spells.body:
Level 4 Transmutation (Cleric, Druid, Ranger)

Casting time: Action

Range: Self

Components: V, S, M (a tuft of bear fur)

Duration: Concentration , up to 10 minutes

You imbue yourself with the claws of a bear. You transform your arms into a pair of muscular, furred paws and make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to 3d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier and, if the target is no more than one size category larger than you, it has the Prone condition. For the duration of the spell, you can make attacks with the claws.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell using a 5th- or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d10. When you cast it using a 7th- or 8th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 5d10. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to 6d8.

spells.name: Coldheart
spells.summary: You cause a supernatural chill to fall upon one Beast or Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it receives 1 Exhaustion level.
spells.body:
Level 1 Necromancy (Druid)

Casting time: Action

Range: 30 feet

Components: V, S

Duration: Instantaneous

You cause a supernatural chill to fall upon one Beast or Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it receives 1 Exhaustion level.

At the end of its next turn, the target must make another Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature receives 1 Exhaustion level. Then the spell ends. Exhaustion applied by this spell is not removed by the end of the spell.

spells.name: Compel Avarice
spells.summary: This spell twists the target creature’s perceptions, inflaming its greed. You choose an object you can see when you cast this spell. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to try to take that item for itself for the duration of the spell. It will try to
spells.body:
Level 3 Enchantment (Cleric, Sorcerer, Wizard)

Casting time: Action

Range: 30 feet

Components: V, S, M (a gold coin)

Duration: Concentration , up to 1 minute

This spell twists the target creature’s perceptions, inflaming its greed. You choose an object you can see when you cast this spell. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to try to take that item for itself for the duration of the spell. It will try to steal the item if possible, and if it is unable to, it will fight the item’s current holder. If the target is able to claim the object, it will flee from all other creatures to jealously guard it until the spell ends. Creatures that have Immunity to the Charmed condition automatically succeed on their saving throws against this spell.

spells.name: Disrupt the Wyrd
spells.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to a saving throw being rolled by a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
spells.components: V, S, M (a tangle of thread)
spells.summary: The creature rerolls the saving throw, either adding your spellcasting modifier to or subtracting it from the new roll. It must use the new result.
spells.body:
Level 2 Abjuration (Cleric)

Casting time: Reaction, which you take in response to a saving throw being rolled by a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself

Range: 30 feet

Components: V, S, M (a tangle of thread)

Duration: Instantaneous

The creature rerolls the saving throw, either adding your spellcasting modifier to or subtracting it from the new roll. It must use the new result.

spells.name: Drummer’s Cadence
spells.summary: For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 60-foot Emanation . Whenever an allied ship in this area moves by oar, its Speed increases by 10 ft. The vessel must be sufficiently crewed for this spell to have any effect.
spells.body:
Level 1 Enchantment (Bard)

Casting time: Action

Range: Self

Components: V

Duration: Concentration , up to 8 hours

For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 60-foot Emanation . Whenever an allied ship in this area moves by oar, its Speed increases by 10 ft. The vessel must be sufficiently crewed for this spell to have any effect.

spells.name: Earthsail
spells.components: V, S, M (a handful of mud and a handful of sea water)
spells.summary: You touch a sailing vessel with a crew of up to 10 throughout the spell’s casting, imbuing it with the ability to treat earth as though it were sea. For the duration, the vessel treats soil, mud, and packed dirt as though it were water, pushing through it and leaving a rippling w
spells.body:
Level 4 Transmutation (Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard)

Casting time: 1 minute or Ritual

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (a handful of mud and a handful of sea water)

Duration: 8 hours

You touch a sailing vessel with a crew of up to 10 throughout the spell’s casting, imbuing it with the ability to treat earth as though it were sea. For the duration, the vessel treats soil, mud, and packed dirt as though it were water, pushing through it and leaving a rippling wake of re-solidified terrain. Snow, ice, plants (including trees), and small stones are temporarily swept aside in the ship’s wake, but boulders and mountains must be sailed around.

spells.name: Encase in Ice
spells.components: V, S, M (a handful of water)
spells.summary: A crashing wave of water fills a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. The water instantly freezes in place. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature’s legs are trapped in the ice, and the creature has the Restrained
spells.body:
Level 2 Conjuration (Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard)

Casting time: Action

Range: 60 feet

Components: V, S, M (a handful of water)

Duration: Concentration , up to 1 minute

A crashing wave of water fills a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. The water instantly freezes in place. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature’s legs are trapped in the ice, and the creature has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature with the Restrained condition can use an action to make a Strength ( Athletics ) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success. Another creature can take the Help action to attempt to free the trapped creature, making the same check.

Creatures that were not in the spell’s area when you cast it treat the area as Difficult Terrain . If a creature that is not Restrained by the ice enters the area or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell with a 3rd-level spell slot, the ice entraps the target’s arms as well as its legs. The target cannot take the Attack action or cast spells with somatic components until the Restrained condition ends.

If you cast this spell using a 5th-level spell slot, the ice completely entombs creatures in the area when you cast the spell. Creatures that fail their initial save are Restrained and have Total Cover for the spell’s duration. An affected creature can make a Strength save at the end of each of its turns to break out, but whether it succeeds or fails, it takes 2d6 Cold damage as its flesh, which was stuck to the ice, tears.

spells.name: Ensnared Threads
spells.components: V, S, M (a knotted string of wool)
spells.summary: The Norns allow you to briefly force a connection between the threads of your fate and those of another creature. A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you form a connection between yourself and the target.
spells.body:
Level 6 Divination (Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard)

Casting time: Action

Range: 60 feet

Components: V, S, M (a knotted string of wool)

Duration: 1 minute

The Norns allow you to briefly force a connection between the threads of your fate and those of another creature. A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you form a connection between yourself and the target.

Once per turn, until the spell ends, the first attack that hits you hits the target creature instead, if it can be targeted by the attack. If that creature cannot be the target of the attack, the attack hits you normally.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell with an 8th- or 9th- level spell slot, all attacks that hit you instead hit the target. Any of the attacks the creature cannot be the target of still hit you normally.

spells.name: Extinguish
spells.summary: You extinguish all magical and nonmagical flames of your choice in a 60-foot Cube originating from you. Creatures made partially or completely of fire take 1d12 Force damage.

Casting time: Action

Range: Self

Components: V

Duration: Instantaneous

You extinguish all magical and nonmagical flames of your choice in a 60-foot Cube originating from you. Creatures made partially or completely of fire take 1d12 Force damage.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. For each spell slot above 1st that you use to cast this spell, the cube increases by 10 feet and affected creatures take an additional 1d12 Force damage.

spells.name: Eyes of the Raven
spells.summary: You call upon the power of Wotan’s all-knowing ravens, Huginn and Muninn. While the spell lasts, you have Advantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saves.

spells.name: Hungry Jaws of Fenris
spells.summary: As a Magic action, you channel the power of Fenris, the Great Wolf, transforming your mouth into a gaping maw. This doesn’t impede your movement or actions, but you can’t speak or cast spells with verbal components for the duration.
spells.body:
Level 6 Transmutation (Druid)

Casting time: Action

Range: Self

Components: V, S, M

Duration: Concentration , up to 1 minute

As a Magic action, you channel the power of Fenris, the Great Wolf, transforming your mouth into a gaping maw. This doesn’t impede your movement or actions, but you can’t speak or cast spells with verbal components for the duration.

While the spell is active, you can use your jaws to make a bite attack. On a hit, the target takes Piercing damage equal to 4d10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and it has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

If you bite a target already Grappled by you, you can choose to swallow it, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature is shunted into a pocket dimension. While there, it has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the dimension, and takes 19 (3d12) Force damage at the start of each of your turns. You can’t swallow a creature if you have already swallowed a creature using this spell.

A swallowed creature can make a save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, you vomit the creature to the nearest unoccupied space of your choice. The same thing occurs if the spell’s duration elapses.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage dealt by the bite attack increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 6th.

spells.name: Ice Shape
spells.summary: You touch a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape the ice into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through the ice that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape ice to seal a n
spells.body:

Casting time: Action

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (a thread)

Duration: Instantaneous

You touch a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape the ice into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through the ice that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape ice to seal a narrow cavern opening shut. Any object you create is crude but functional, but finer mechanical detail isn’t possible.

spells.body:

Treat your weight as one-tenth normal for the purpose of breaking through thin ice

spells.body:

A creature that can hear you within the spell’s range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends. While the creature is Charmed, it is Friendly toward you, and it takes no actions other than to sing along with the song. For the duration of the song, you may use a Bonus Action to target a new creature that is within 30 feet of you or of another creature singing the song. You can affect a total number of creatures equal to your Spellcasting ability modifier at any one time, adding them progressively. A targeted creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Charmed by you and begin singing along. If any of the singers other than you is attacked during the song, the song stops with a loud discordant note, and the spell ends for everyone affected.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell with a 3rd or higher-level spell slot, you can affect 2 creatures each time you take a Bonus Action to spread the song.

spells.body:

Casting time: Action

You call forth the spirit of the mythical leviathan. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Leviathan Spirit stat block. The space you choose must be filled with enough water to contain the size of the leviathan, otherwise the spell ends immediately. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The leviathan is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

spells.name: Sun Rune
spells.summary: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell’s material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. You can only have one Sun Rune spell active at a time.
spells.body:
Level 6 Evocation (Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard)

Casting time: 1 minute

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (a Tiny stone)

Duration: 8 hours

You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell’s material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. You can only have one Sun Rune spell active at a time.

Once while the spell lasts, any creature holding the stone may use an Action to invoke the rune’s power and throw it at a target up to 60 feet away. It stops early if it impacts against a solid surface. When the stone lands or impacts, the rune triggers.

When the rune triggers, the blazing heat of the sun flashes in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on the stone. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d6 Fire damage and 4d6 Radiant damage, or half as much on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Sphere that aren’t being worn or carried start burning. Ice or snow within the Sphere vaporizes into a fog that fills the Sphere, making it Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong wind (such as one created by the Gust of Wind spell) disperses it.

After activating the rune’s power, the creature cannot activate another Sun Rune again until after a Long Rest .

spells.body:
Level 3 Evocation (Druid, Ranger)

Casting time: Action or Ritual

Range: 30 feet

Components: V, S, M (a freshly packed snowball)

Duration: Concentration , up to 10 minutes

You create a wall of packed snow on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick. Or you can make a 10-foot-radius, hemispherical dome. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.

If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Fire and Radiant damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it.

Creatures within an undamaged dome have Immunity to the effects of Extreme Cold while the spell lasts.

If you cast this spell in an area of snowy terrain, it blends seamlessly with the existing snow. If a creature takes a Study action to examine the wall, the creature can differentiate the wall from the surrounding terrain with a successful Intelligence ( Investigation ) check against your spell save DC.

A creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

spells.body:

Casting time: Action

Range: 90 feet

Components: V, S

Duration: Concentration , up to 1 minute

You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.

When you cast this spell, you create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of heavy fog and flurrying snow centered on you. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured and the terrain within it is Difficult Terrain . Any creature that begins its turn in the Sphere or enters the Sphere on its turn must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or receive 1 Exhaustion level. Creatures that have Resistance or Immunity to Cold damage automatically succeed on this save.

When you cast the spell, you may designate a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. These creatures do not receive levels of Exhaustion from the spell.

When the spell ends, all snow created by it disappears instantly and the Exhaustion levels end.
